notes: The Israeli periodic interval of 15,000 km / 12 months (whichever first) is quoted from two Israeli importer sources: Global Automax's C-HR guide, and toyota.co.il, Union Motors' Toyota Israel site, in a generic article. It is corroborated by NZ Toyota, an AU forum and servicereset (EU). Toyota UK states 10,000 miles / 12 months. No Union Motors C-HR-specific service booklet and no EU/IL itemized C-HR schedule were accessible. All item-level intervals (spark plugs 90,000 km / 6 y, ECVT fluid 90,000 km / 6 y, air filter 75,000 km / 5 y, coolant first 150,000 km / 10 y then every 75,000 km, brake fluid 30,000 km / 2 y, HEV intake filter clean 30,000 km / 2 y) come from ONE official source: the Toyota NZ generic petrol-hybrid 'Service Requirements' sheet (Sept 2023). That sheet is not C-HR- or model-year-specific and is for the NZ market, so treat its items as single-source. Brake fluid (Midrag IL; servicereset) and coolant time (servicereset) have partial independent corroboration. The toyota.co.il article lists generic service contents (oil, brake fluid, coolant, spark plugs, filters) without intervals, so it was not used for items. US data (KBB) is for the US 2019 C-HR, whose engine differs; it is kept only for conflict tracking. No timing belt applies to 2ZR-FXE (it has a chain), but no quoted source was found stating this, so no item was recorded.
